meta.title: Eqho: offline dictation for Windows
meta.description: Press Alt + Q in any app, talk, and your words appear at the cursor. Speech recognition runs on your own PC, in 99 languages, on your graphics card or processor. On the Microsoft Store with a 15-day free trial.
meta.ogAlt: Eqho: Speak anywhere. It just types.
nav.storeAria: Get Eqho on the Microsoft Store
theme.label: Theme
hero.lede: Press Alt + Q in any app, talk naturally, and your words appear where your cursor is. Eqho listens on your own PC, so your voice never leaves it.
hero.trial: Try it free for 15 days, then buy it once.
hero.demoText: Everything went smoothly in today's review. The new build starts in a blink, stays quiet in the tray and turns my voice into text without going online.
hero.demoLabel: Eqho typing dictated words into a notes window while the listening pill moves with the voice.
how.label: How it works
how.title: Click, talk, done.
how.lede: There is nothing to learn. Eqho works anywhere you can type.
how.s1.title: Click where the text should go
how.s1.body: An email, a document, a chat, a code editor. If you can type there, you can speak there.
how.s2.title: Press Alt + Q and talk
how.s2.body: The listening pill appears and moves with your voice. It never takes the focus away from your app.
how.s3.title: Press Alt + Q again
how.s3.body: Your words appear at the cursor with punctuation and capitals. Rather hold the key while you speak? Switch to Hold-to-Talk.
delivery.label: Batch or Live
delivery.title: Choose how your words arrive
delivery.body: Batch pastes the whole thought when you stop speaking. Live types it phrase by phrase while you talk. Hover over the pill to switch modes, change the language or cancel quietly, without opening a window.
delivery.shotAlt: The Eqho dashboard with microphone, hotkey, language, custom vocabulary and delivery settings
private.label: Privacy
private.title: Your voice stays on your PC
private.body: Speech recognition runs on your own processor or graphics card. There is no account to create and no cloud service in between. Your recordings and your words are not sent anywhere.
private.p1.title: No account
private.p2.title: No subscription
private.p2.body: Pay once after the trial and keep it.
private.p3.title: Open source
private.p3.body: The code is public under AGPL-3.0, so anyone can check it.
speed.label: Speed
speed.title: Fast on a gaming PC or a thin laptop
speed.body: Eqho uses your graphics card through Vulkan, whether it is NVIDIA, AMD or Intel, or spreads the work across your processor cores. You choose a voice model once: compact ones start at 60 MB, and the largest is about 1.6 GB.
speed.stat1.label: of memory while it waits in the tray
speed.stat2.label: for the smallest voice model
speed.stat3.label: languages to dictate in
speed.shotAlt: The Models tab with English and multilingual voice models and their sizes
langs.label: Languages
langs.title: 99 languages, labeled honestly
langs.body: Thirteen languages are tuned for dictation and twenty more are strong. The other 66 that Whisper supports are there too, marked experimental so you know what to expect. You can switch language from the pill while you dictate.
langs.experimentalBody: 66 more languages, from Afrikaans to Yoruba. Results vary.
details.label: Details
details.title: Small things that add up
details.d1.title: Private clipboard
details.d1.body: Pasted text stays out of your Windows clipboard history. Or let Eqho type it out instead.
details.d2.title: Custom vocabulary
details.d2.body: Add the names and terms Eqho should spell your way.
details.d3.title: Voice commands
details.d3.body: Turn them on and say "new line", "period" or "delete that" as you go.
details.d4.title: Nothing gets lost
details.d4.body: If there is no text field to paste into, your words wait in History, ready to copy.
details.d5.title: Searchable history
details.d5.body: Every dictation is kept on your PC, searchable by word or date. Deleted ones wait in Recently Deleted, then clear themselves.
details.d6.title: Quieter while you speak
details.d6.body: Eqho can lower or mute other sounds while you dictate, then bring them back.
details.d7.title: Light and dark
details.d7.body: Follows your Windows theme, or pick the one you like.
details.d8.title: Guided setup
details.d8.body: A short first-run setup tests your microphone and helps you pick a voice model.
details.shotAlt: The History tab with searchable transcripts and a recovered dictation
start.label: Get Eqho
start.title: Try it free for 15 days, then buy it once.
start.body: Get Eqho from the Microsoft Store. Every feature works during the trial. If you keep it, you pay once, with no subscription and no word limits.
start.req: Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit. A graphics card helps but is not needed.
start.other: On Linux or macOS? The previous version (0.8.10) runs there and is {link}. A macOS version of Eqho 0.9 is in development.
faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Questions
faq.a1: Eqho is a one-time purchase on the Microsoft Store, with a 15-day free trial first. There is no subscription, no word limit and no ads.
faq.a2: No. Transcription runs on your own processor or graphics card, using open Whisper speech models through whisper.cpp. Your audio and your text are not sent anywhere. The {link} lists every time Eqho uses the network.
faq.a3: Yes. Eqho comes from the Microsoft Store, which checks every app before it is listed, and its source code is public on GitHub.
faq.a4: Eqho uses the Whisper family of speech models, which cope well with accents and background noise. You choose the balance: compact models from 60 MB are quick even on a laptop processor, and larger models are more accurate with difficult audio.
faq.a5: Yes. Alt + Q is the default. You can pick another shortcut in the General tab and choose between Toggle and Hold-to-Talk.
faq.q6: What do I need to run it?
faq.a6: A 64-bit PC with Windows 10 or 11, and 60 MB to 1.6 GB of disk space for the voice model you choose. A graphics card from NVIDIA, AMD or Intel makes it faster but is not required.
faq.q7: Does it work on Linux or macOS?
faq.a7: Eqho 0.9 runs on Windows, and a macOS version is in development. The previous version (0.8.10) runs on Linux and macOS and is {link}.
faq.a8: Uninstall it from Windows Settings. That also removes its settings.

privacy.metaDescription: Privacy policy for Eqho — 100% offline voice-to-text dictation. Your voice is processed locally on your PC and never uploaded.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.lede: Eqho does not collect, store on any server, sell, or share your personal data or voice recordings. Everything runs locally on your computer.
privacy.mic.title: Microphone & voice audio
privacy.mic.p1: Eqho accesses your microphone only while you actively dictate (after you press your chosen hotkey or click Start Dictation). As soon as you stop or cancel dictation, the microphone stream closes immediately.
privacy.mic.p2: All speech recognition runs 100% locally on your own CPU or graphics card using `whisper.cpp`. Audio is kept in memory only for the duration of the phrase being transcribed — it is never written to disk and never sent over the internet.
privacy.files.title: Files stored locally on your computer
privacy.files.p1: Eqho keeps only your local configuration and downloaded speech models on your own device:
privacy.files.li1: **Settings** (`%APPDATA%\Eqho\settings.json` on Windows · `~/.config/Eqho/settings.json` on Linux · `~/Library/Application Support/Eqho/settings.json` on macOS) — your hotkey, language, theme, overlay, custom vocabulary, and replacement preferences.
privacy.files.li2: **Transcript history** (`history.jsonl` in your Eqho config folder) — local transcript history (optional; can be disabled or cleared at any time in Eqho).
privacy.files.li3: **Diagnostic logs** (`eqho.log` in your Eqho config folder) — technical diagnostics and crash logs. Your dictated text and audio are never written to log files.
privacy.files.li4: **Store licence cache** (`%APPDATA%\Eqho\license.json`, Microsoft Store edition only) — locally cached Store trial or purchase status so Eqho continues working while offline.
privacy.files.li5: **Downloaded speech models** (`%LOCALAPPDATA%\Eqho\models\` on Windows · `~/.cache/Eqho/models/` on Linux · `~/Library/Caches/Eqho/models/` on macOS) — local GGML Whisper speech model files that you choose to download.
privacy.files.p2: Deleting those folders removes all Eqho data from your computer.
privacy.network.title: Network activity
privacy.network.li1: **Downloading a speech model you choose:** When you download a Whisper model during first-run setup or in the Models tab, Eqho fetches the selected GGML model file over HTTPS from Hugging Face. Once downloaded, dictation works completely offline.
privacy.network.li2: **Microsoft Store licence checks (Store edition only):** The Microsoft Store edition uses the built-in Windows `Windows.Services.Store.StoreContext` API to check your 15-day free trial or purchase status through the Microsoft Store.
privacy.clipboard.title: Clipboard & active window
privacy.clipboard.p1: When inserting dictated text using Clipboard mode, Eqho marks the pasted text as private (excluded from Windows Win+V clipboard history and cloud clipboard sync) and restores your previous clipboard text immediately afterward. Eqho reads the active window handle solely to restore focus before inserting your dictation and to apply any per-app paste rules you configure.
privacy.ai.title: Development & generative AI disclosure
privacy.ai.p1: Eqho is designed, directed, tested, and maintained by **damt.xyz** with extensive use of generative AI tools, from start to finish: most of the application code and tests, the documentation, packaging and build automation, this website, the store listing and other marketing materials, and ongoing maintenance.
privacy.ai.p2: This applies strictly to how Eqho is developed and marketed. When you run Eqho, no cloud AI or generative language model is called — speech recognition runs locally via `whisper.cpp` on your own hardware, and text formatting is deterministic.
privacy.ai.p3: Throughout, a real person steers the work and decides what is released.
privacy.site.title: This website & contact
privacy.site.p1: This documentation site uses no cookies, no analytics scripts, and no third-party tracking.
privacy.network.intro: Eqho contains no ads, no user accounts, and no mandatory tracking. Network requests occur only in these explicit cases:
privacy.network.introNoAnalytics: Eqho contains no telemetry, no analytics, no ads, and no user accounts. Network requests occur only in two explicit cases:
privacy.network.analytics: **Optional anonymous usage analytics (opt-in only, off by default):** Only if you explicitly turn on Share Anonymous Usage Analytics during setup or in **Settings → Data & Storage**, Eqho sends anonymous product and hardware events (such as app version, OS/architecture, hardware tier, selected model name, and engine/delivery mode) to **PostHog EU Cloud** (`eu.i.posthog.com`) using a random local UUID with person profiles and IP storage disabled (`$process_person_profile: false`, `$ip: null`). Microphone audio, dictated transcripts, custom vocabulary, window titles, filenames, and clipboard contents are never sent. Turning the toggle off stops all analytics immediately and deletes the local anonymous ID.
